description: Find classical crypto files; `format: cyclonedx` gives a CycloneDX 1.7 CBOM (JSON) of the cryptographic material found in files (not crypto in source code, binaries or network traffic), stating only what the scanner read: algorithms it assumes from a file type are marked as assumed. Inline results are cut at 10 KB, and a longer JSON report or CBOM is refused with an error: pass `output` to write the whole report to a file. `format: omb-csv|omb-xlsx|omb-json` writes the OMB M-23-02 inventory report of one system (the memo's nine items; omb-xlsx needs `output`; the memo excludes national security systems), with the system profile `omb_profile` and the omb_* values that override it. Free on all tiers (an account is needed). Strict profile: this tool takes no password, passphrase, private key, API key or payment token.

format.description: text (default), json, csv, html, markdown, cyclonedx (CycloneDX 1.7 CBOM, JSON), omb-csv, omb-xlsx, omb-json (OMB M-23-02 inventory report)

min_risk.description: Minimum risk level: safe, low, medium, high, critical

omb_data_types.description: OMB M-23-02 item 8: types of data

omb_fips199.description: OMB M-23-02 item 2: low, moderate or high

omb_fisma_id.description: OMB M-23-02 item 1: FISMA system identifier (an identifier only)

omb_profile.description: OMB M-23-02 report: the system profile (TOML file)

omb_time_to_live.description: OMB M-23-02 item 8: time to live

output.description: Write the report to this file instead of returning it inline (inline results are limited to 10 KB)

name: qnsqy_scan
title: Scan for quantum-vulnerable cryptography
